purpose: A project-agnostic whole-project feature inventory, independent classification report, and fresh Auditor seed contract.

feature_map.source_binding: The map is valid only when its source commit and tree equal the exact current source identity supplied to validation.

required_rules: Every mapped feature has exactly one classification.
Each classification has at least one source-bound evidence record.
Duplicate, missing, or unknown feature IDs are rejected.
PARTLY_BUILT and NOT_BUILT route to CAMPAIGN_ORCHESTRATOR.
The Auditor cannot be the builder or acceptor of the audited work.
auditor_report.public_reference_rule: Paths and links are project-relative references only; absolute, outside-project, private, and chat references are rejected.

auditor_seed.check_rule: Only one CHECKED seed, content-addressed by seed_sha256 and checked by CAMPAIGN_ORCHESTRATOR, may create a fresh Auditor.

auditor_seed_binding.fresh_rule: A fresh Auditor binding carries exactly one seed digest and the seed's unchanged project, campaign, build, source, and governance binding.
